observations: body L1, L3, L22, L25: the dashes of the transliterated names and of «an–nayrūz» and «ar–Rūm» are long dashes (4.7 to 5.5 pt).
body L2-L3: a fifth of an hour is 12m and 1/400 of an hour 9s, so 365 days + 6 hours + 1/5 + 1/400 hour make 365d 6h 12m 9s, as in the bracket.
body L23: the comma after «tributa» stands high, from the middle of the letters to the line.
notes_left L7-L8: the dash of the years divided between the lines («1889–», «–90») measures 4.3 pt and is a long dash, repeated at the head of L8; that of «209-212» (3.5 pt) is a hyphen.
notes_left L12-L13: rabī‘ I 259 heg. ran from 5 January to 3 February 873 (Julian), so January 873 is right.
notes_left L14: the dash of «al-Bīrūnī» measures 3.5 pt, a hyphen.

notes_right L1-L3: the Arabic quotation begins at the right end of L1 and goes on at the right end of L2; its full stop stands after it, before the dash. The words corrected by Nallino stand in the text, the printed readings of al-Bīrūnī's text after «pro».
notes_right L9: ṣafar 288 heg. ran from 25 January to 22 February 901 (Julian), mostly in February.
notes_right L10: the dash of «20-21» (3.5 pt) is a hyphen; that of «34–38» is longer and joined to the figures, a long dash.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
